shared_bank.motion_and_visibility: sustained visible motion, varied textures/depths; no mostly static post-drop clips
shared_bank.illumination_within_rollout: constant; vary predetermined scene parameters across rollouts, no test-driven fitting
shared_bank.labels: common physical endpoint projections; count-independent labels; geometry/visibility validity recorded and identical
shared_bank.manifest_rule: write and hash actual complete paired bank/split before first optimizer update; no mutable bank append within run

v2e_input_mapping.input: scene-linear RGB radiance from the same Genesis endpoint render
v2e_input_mapping.display_transform: Reinhard(Y) followed by sRGB transfer function
v2e_input_mapping.status: fixed engineering mapping for the pipeline pilot; not sensor calibrated

generators.mapping_policy: retain accepted fixed mapping, uncalibrated; claim scope is complete native input/event-generation pipelines

flow_dt1.window_rule: (t_i,t_i+3] on the 100Hz bank; take every third endpoint without overlaps between basic intervals
flow_dt1.representation: same accepted five equal-count Gaussian ON/OFF slices in each fixed physical interval
flow_dt1.remainder_empty_tied_overflow_policy: retain accepted guarded encoder identically for both arms
flow_dt1.validation: all 8 held-out rollouts; native raster with deterministic padding/crop; complete two-component output
flow_dt1.GT_use: synthetic_validation_only; grayscale targets allowed in training loss, no GT flow as model input
flow_dt1.gradient_accumulation: allowed, average gradients to effective batch
flow_dt1.selection: minimum synthetic validation EPE; frame then rollout equal weight; tie -> earlier epoch

reconstruction.representation: five signed temporally interpolated bins; no additional event normalization

loss.flow_source: shared physical displacement with same transforms as images/events

reconstruction.reset_state: every training clip; synthetic validation rollout start
reconstruction.selection: minimum synthetic validation LPIPS-VGG, equal rollout weight; tie -> earlier epoch

runtime.checkpoint: first 20 updates and periodic resumable last; retain synthetic-best; do not dump every iteration
runtime.GPU_allocation: recheck occupancy; prefer available GPUs 0/1 for paired primary; protect other users; GPU3 occupied at research check

engineering_runtime_amendment.reason: The locked CPU NumPy per-sample path did not finish the first 10 ms interval within the recorded ~8 minute v3 attempt.
engineering_runtime_amendment.comparison: Existing CUDA batch projection/warp; same physical and sensor parameters; finite precision differs from NumPy reference as recorded in the amendment.

content.event_window: (t_i,t_i+3] on shared 100Hz endpoints; starts at i=0,3,...,195; the remaining 20ms of each 2s rollout is excluded by the registered 66-window count
